Themes/Colors/Example Plot for Testing

Code 
mn_colors <- c(
  "#E3E038", # yellow
  "#43CE79", # green
  "#4EAFAD", # teal
  "#1F4C5E",  # navy
  "#8B8B8B"
)

# Custom MN color scale (fill)
scale_fill_mn <- function(...) {
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = mn_colors, ...)
}

# Custom MN theme
theme_mn <- function() {
    theme(
      text = element_text(family = 'Soleil'),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
      axis.line = element_line(colour = NULL),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA),
      #panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "black", size = 15, family = "Soleil"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16, family = "Soleil"),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16, family = "Soleil"),
      strip.text.x = element_text(size = 16, color = "#1F4C5E", family = "Soleil", face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 24, color = "black", hjust = 0, family = "Soleil", face =  "bold"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 18, color = "gray30", hjust = 0, family = "Soleil"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, color = "black", hjust = 1, family = "Soleil"),
      strip.background = element_rect(colour = NULL, fill = 'white'),
    )
  

}

Reading In The Data

Code 
library(readxl)

# Read in the Excel file
baseball <- read_excel("bbupdated.xlsx")
Code 
baseball <- baseball |>
  mutate(Season = ifelse(year(Date) == 2025, "2025", "2026"))
Code 
season_summary <- baseball |>
  filter(!(year(Date) == 2025 & Date > as.Date("2025-04-20"))) |>
  group_by(Season) |>
  summarise(
    games = n(),
    Wins = sum(`W/L` == "W", na.rm = TRUE),
    Losses = sum(`W/L` == "L", na.rm = TRUE),
    total_H = sum(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_AB = sum(AB, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_RBI = sum(RBI, na.rm = TRUE),
    AVG = total_H / total_AB,
    Win_Pct = Wins / games
  )

Here were the RBI & Win Relationship Graphs You Asked For

Code 
# Create win indicator
baseball2 <- baseball |>
  mutate(
    Season = ifelse(year(Date) == 2025, "2025", "2026"),
    Win = ifelse(`W/L` == "W", 1, 0)
  )

# RBI vs win result (all games through April 20 for each season comparison)
rbi_wins <- baseball2 |>
  filter(month(Date) < 4 | (month(Date) == 4 & day(Date) <= 20))

ggplot(rbi_wins, aes(x = RBI, y = Win, color = Season)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.08, width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("Loss", "Win")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "RBI and Game Result by Season",
    subtitle = "Each point is one game",
    x = "RBI",
    y = "Game Result",
    caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News"
  ) +
  theme_mn()
Code 
april_rbi_wins <- baseball2 |>
  filter(month(Date) == 4, day(Date) <= 20)

ggplot(april_rbi_wins, aes(x = RBI, y = Win, color = Season)) +
  geom_jitter(height = 0.08, width = 0.15, alpha = 0.7, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "glm", method.args = list(family = "binomial"), se = FALSE, linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = c(0, 1),
    labels = c("Loss", "Win")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "April RBI and Game Result by Season",
    subtitle = "Each point is one April game",
    x = "RBI",
    y = "Game Result",
    caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News"
  ) +
  theme_mn()
Code 
ggplot(rbi_wins, aes(x = `W/L`, y = RBI, fill = Season)) +
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) +
  labs(
    title = "RBI by Game Result and Season",
    x = "Game Result",
    y = "RBI",
    caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News"
  ) +
  theme_mn() +
  scale_fill_mn()

Code 
monthly_summary <- baseball |>
  filter(month(Date) < 4 | (month(Date) == 4 & day(Date) <= 20)) |>
  mutate(
    Month = month(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE)
  ) |>
  group_by(Season, Month) |>
  summarise(
    games = n(),
    Wins = sum(`W/L` == "W", na.rm = TRUE),
    Losses = sum(`W/L` == "L", na.rm = TRUE),

    total_H = sum(H, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_AB = sum(AB, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_HR = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    total_RBI = sum(RBI, na.rm = TRUE),

    AVG = total_H / total_AB,
    Win_Pct = Wins / games,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

monthly_summary <- monthly_summary |>
  mutate(Month = factor(Month, levels = c("February", "March", "April")))

Graph of HRs by Month & Season

ggplot(monthly_summary, aes(x = Month, y = total_HR, fill = Season)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  labs(title = "Home Runs by Month and Season",

       y = "Total Home Runs") +
  theme_mn() +

Some More Complex Plots

Home Run Totals Increasing by Games Played By Season

Code 
running <- baseball |>
  filter(month(Date) < 4 | (month(Date) == 4 & day(Date) <= 20)) |>
  arrange(Season, Date) |>
  group_by(Season) |>
  mutate(
    game_number = row_number(),
    cum_HR = cumsum(HR),
    cum_RBI = cumsum(RBI),
    cum_Wins = cumsum(`W/L` == "W")
  )

ggplot(running, aes(x = game_number, y = cum_HR, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Home Runs by Game Number and Season",
    x = "Game Number",
    y = "Total Home Runs",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News") +
  theme_mn()

Batting Average Ups and Downs by Season

Code 
library(zoo)

rolling <- baseball |>
  filter(month(Date) < 4 | (month(Date) == 4 & day(Date) <= 20)) |>
  arrange(Season, Date) |>
  group_by(Season) |>
  mutate(
    game_number = row_number(),
    rolling_H = zoo::rollsum(H, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    rolling_AB = zoo::rollsum(AB, k = 5, fill = NA, align = "right"),
    AVG_rolling = rolling_H / rolling_AB
  ) |>
  ungroup()

ggplot(rolling, aes(x = game_number, y = AVG_rolling, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Rolling Batting Average by Game Number and Season",
    x = "Game Number",
    y = "Rolling Batting AVG",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News") +
  theme_mn()

Trend Line For Wins by Games Played By Season

Code 
ggplot(running, aes(x = game_number, y = cum_Wins, color = Season)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c(
    "2025" = "#E3E038",
    "2026" = "#43CE79"
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Cumulative Wins by Game Number and Season",
    x = "Game Number",
    y = "Cumulative Wins",
       caption = "Addison Weaver | Mustang News") +
  theme_mn()

    "2025" = "#E3E038",

  )) +

    cum_Wins = cumsum(`W/L` == "W")
  )

ggplot(running, aes(x = game_number, y = cum_HR, color = Season)) +
